notes.title: Lunar New Year
notes.content:
Game update in connection with the celebration of the Lunar New Year,
Added single player mode
Two new locations
Two new heroes and a new Boss for killing which you can get the Steam achievement
[previewyoutube=WU64NkTh44Q;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Years battle
notes.content:
In Boss Kill mode, you can become a cool Santa Claus who smashes everyone with a very cool sword. And his gifts are very explosive.
Or gather a team of friends and get revenge on Santa Claus for bad gifts. Yes. you need friends because you can't handle him alone.
Only while this event is in effect you have the opportunity to get the achievement "Kill Santa Claus"
[previewyoutube=3ks8VRt_lfM;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
